summary: Your ninth teach-back. You answer a colleague who wants big chunks, explain why chunk size matters in 5 sentences, check six key points, and test your explanation against the table you made on Thursday.
goal: Explain why chunk size matters, with real numbers.

items.text: Write what you would answer the colleague and one case for small and one for big chunks
Explain why chunk size matters in 5 sentences or a 60-second voice note
Tick the six key points your explanation said clearly and count them
Check your explanation against the Thursday table and use its numbers
Write a better sentence for the biggest gap
Play the Why Chunk Size game to the end and see your score
